FriendForge Test Study Notes

Database normalization reduces data redundancy.

First Normal Form (1NF) requires atomic values and removes repeating groups.

Second Normal Form (2NF) requires 1NF and removes partial dependency on a composite key.

Third Normal Form (3NF) requires 2NF and removes transitive dependencies.

The test code for this document is FF-RAG-2026.

This file exists only for RAG verification.
